_comment: Fixture zones for bhop_arcane (cfg/test/p403ride.cfg). Copy to maps/zones/local/bhop_arcane.json for the run and DELETE after -- this map has a real shipped zone file and local wins. Geometry measured by cfg/test/p403probe.cfg. MAIN's start zone sits inside *88 (push +y 1000, y 2048..2560) and stops at y 2555, so the run STARTS with a carrier already armed and then rides *87 (1400, y 2560..3072) and *86 (1800, y 3072..3584) for 1024 u INSIDE the run -- which is where a multi-command ride span can appear. Its end box catches the fall past y~3670 where the floor stops. The first cut put the start zone around *86 itself: the run then began past the booster and lasted 5 ticks, which captured a pay of 1800 but no span. BONUS 1 sits on the floor at z~13600 inside *252 (push UP 1250, world 1024 -11232 13056 .. 2048 -10240 15616): standing there is grounded under an upward push, which is the `lift` warp (sv_entities.qc:5614).
